stem_book: A thin uniform sheet of metal of uniform thickness is cut into the shape bounded by the line x = a and the curves y = ±kx², as shown. The centre of mass lies on the x-axis; find its x-coordinate. (a) (2/3)a (b) (3/4)a (c) (4/5)a (d) (5/6)a
work: x_cm = ∫x·2kx² dx / ∫2kx² dx = (a⁴/4)/(a³/3) = 3a/4; y_cm = 0 by symmetry
